id: title:TueHaulund:save comments made at the start of a recording

review.posthog_relevance: Adds timestamp fallback and submission guard for comments, preventing silent failures when recording start time is unavailable.
review.reason: Adds a fallback timestamp calculation and a guard check before comment submission. This is a localized behavior correction and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: This chunk is not part of the PostHog repository; the supplied observations describe a frontend comment submission feature, not PostHog's backend, warehouse, or shared infrastructure. No PostHog-specific relevance or tier can be established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds dateForCurrentTimestamp state and its selector, replacing the use of currentTimestamp for comment timestamps.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a fallback timestamp derived from recording start time and playhead offset when currentTimestamp is unset, supporting comment submission without a prior seek.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback calculation for dateForCurrentTimestamp using recording start time and playhead offset.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows comments to retain a valid timestamp even when the recording has not been played past the start, preventing silent failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a guard check before submitting a comment, returning an error toast if no timestamp is available.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents submission of comments with missing timestamps, surfacing an error to the user instead of failing silently.
